changes.before: A Hakke robot bearing the title of "Heavens." Its power is the greatest among the Hakke robots. It was built by Tekkoryu but was stolen after completion. It was then secretly placed under the control of the Japanese government, but with Tekkoryu's start of activity it became a target for recapture. It has no optional equipment at all, and fights with beams and shock waves fired from the light spheres on the backs of its hands, and with melee combat. Its finishing move, the "Hades Attack," fired by bringing the light spheres on its chest and both arms together in front of the chest, has the power to break down every atom. It can also deploy a high-output barrier, making it a machine well balanced in both offense and defense. Each Hakke robot can only be piloted by a specific person, but Zeorymer is a special machine that requires two people: main pilot Masato Akitsu and sub-pilot Miku Himuro. However, Miku is only support, and only Masato can pilot it. Masato alone can also move it, but its power drops. It is housed in the hangar of the Japanese government's secret base "Last Guardian," beneath the Aokigahara sea of trees, in a state divided into four parts: the chest light sphere, upper torso, both arms, and lower body.

changes.before: A 15-year-old junior high school student who is thrown into a mad battle regardless of his own will. He lived a comfortable life without any connection to Tekkoryu, but he holds faint memories and knowledge about Zeorymer in his subconscious, and can pilot Zeorymer unconsciously. He is a shy, ordinary boy, with a gentle side that refuses to make sacrifices and cannot be ruthless. However, he has a duality in which his personality changes to a vicious one during combat; he fears this self and suffers in agony. When his personality becomes vicious, his gaze sharpens and the color of his eyes changes. Zeorymer piloted in this state displays its true power, and keeps the other Hakke robots at bay with overwhelming attack power and high-speed movement.

changes.before: The creator of Masato Akitsu, Miku Himuro and the Hakkeshu. Fifteen years ago, the original Masaki Kihara was an engineer of Tekkoryu, but he fled taking Zeorymer, and immediately afterward was killed by the Japanese government, which feared his defecting. However, he had set into the fertilized egg of his clone Masato that Masaki's personality would awaken when Masato rides Zeorymer, and so he achieves resurrection. The reason Zeorymer can be moved only by Masato and Masaki is that the genes of Masato's fertilized egg were input to the pilot registration system. As an engineer he is a genius, showing talent not only in bioengineering but also in mechanical engineering, and he built the Dimensional Coupler System. He is cruel and cunning, and does not hesitate to sacrifice others for his own aims. His goal is to become the King of the Underworld himself, and having calculated that either the Japanese government or Tekkoryu would rule the world, he left a clone of himself with both of them.

changes.before: The 20-year-old emperor of Tekkoryu, a giant society plotting world domination. Tekkoryu, known by the nickname Hau Dragon, lay hidden underground for fifteen years behind the hardware company International Electronic Brains, but began to act as soon as the Hakke robots were completed, and is carrying out the Hades Project to turn the world into the underworld and reign as the King of the Underworld herself. Before being chosen as emperor she was one of the Hakkeshu and was supposed to become Zeorymer's pilot. She and Taiha love each other, but because of her position as emperor she cannot love him as a single man.
